title: 3 new things in your app!
intro: Today fits on one screen now: your one card and your next finish line. Your pet, your Backstage Pass and the week moved to Me. The extras wait on Play, under the games.
mom: New for Mom: Today is one screen: the card, the next finish line (tap it for ✓ Made it) and the Sunday sheet on Sundays. The pet, the Pass, What's new and the week strip are on Me; the extras on Play; this week's fix on Practice.

items.pitch: One card with one big button. Your next finish line is the line under it.
steps: Today is one card: the big button starts what today needs.
On the card: “🎵 Solo”, “🎵 Trio”, “📹 Videos” and “🧠 Memorize”.
Tap the 🎯 line under the card: your finish lines open, with ✓ Made it.
When the plan is done, “Pick something fun on Play ›” shows up.

items.n: Your pet and your Pass on Me
items.pitch: Your pet, your Backstage Pass and the week live on Me now, right under your dancer.
steps: Tap Me at the bottom. Your pet is right under your dancer.
Under the pet: “My Backstage Pass”, then “This week”.
A pink dot on Me means something new is waiting there.

items.pitch: Pick one extra, how you feel today and this week's mind skill are on Play, under the games.
steps: Open Play and scroll past the games.
“✨ Pick one extra” has a trick, a game, a move and Memorize it.
“✨ More for today” has how you feel and this week's mind skill.
